purpose: Teach: 異端/卑怯/束縛/醜い/人為/援護/邪悪/監獄

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、異端的な治療法も医療チームで慎重に検討します
lines.en: We examine unconventional treatment approaches carefully as a team.
lines.style: Clear and measured. Even tone without rushing. Precise enunciation on the key words. Direct eye contact. The voice of someone who has explained this before and will again.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者さんに対する卑怯な扱いを医療チームで戒めます
lines.en: We make sure our team never treats patients with anything less than respect.
lines.style: Calm but firm. Quiet conviction beneath the surface. No defensiveness — stating fact. Slight pause before the key phrase, as if wanting to be certain she's clear.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 束縛なき医療を、貴院、目指されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does pursue medicine without constraints, doesn't it, Dr. Saito?
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuine curiosity. Soft voice, careful phrasing. Respectful distance — he's asking to understand, not to challenge. Slight upward lift at the end, genuine question.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、外見が醜い傷を治す形成外科を医療チームで担います
lines.en: Yes, our plastic surgery team works to heal wounds—visible and invisible alike.
lines.style: Steady and clear. Emphasis on the broader meaning beneath the clinical word. Warm but professional. A slight softening on the second part, showing the human purpose behind the technical skill.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 人為的な健康被害の研究を、貴院、なさってますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital does research into iatrogenic harm, doesn't it, Dr. Saito?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry, slightly hesitant. He's working through the question as he asks it. Respectful tone — not accusatory, genuinely trying to understand what the hospital prioritizes.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者さん家族の援護も医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, our team also supports patients' families through every step of their care.
lines.style: Unhurried and assured. The voice of someone describing what they do as simply as breathing. No need to elaborate or convince — the work speaks.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 邪悪な意図で患者を扱う医療事案、貴院、警戒されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital watches carefully for any case where patients might be treated with harmful intent, doesn't it, Dr. Saito?
lines.style: Serious and measured. He's moved into deeper ethical territory. Voice steady but intent. Respectful but not deferential — this is a real question about real responsibility.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、監獄内の医療支援を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, we provide medical support to those in prison as well.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact and quiet. No hesitation or apology for the statement. The words land with quiet weight. Close to the listener — intimate in its clarity without being theatrical.
